name: IBY_TRXN_CORE
description: IBY_BEPKEYS stores information about the payment systems.

columns.name: TRXNMID
columns.description: Primary key as well as foreign key associating the POS data with a single credit card transaction

columns.name: TERMINALID
columns.description: Used  for credit card processing. A merchant can get multiple  terminal identifiers and there is a batch open for each terminal identifier. The merchant could  perform operations on those batches independently.

columns.name: TRACENUMBER
columns.description: Unique transaction identifier for payment system  follow-on transactions

columns.name: AUTHCODE
columns.description: authorization code received from Credit Card Processing System for authorization.

columns.name: REFERENCECODE
columns.description: reference code received from Back End  Payment Systems or processing system which can be  used for reference.

columns.name: OPERATIONCODE
columns.description: Generic code for any operation such as authorization, capture, etc.

columns.name: INSTRNAME
columns.description: payment instrument name such as Visa, MasterCard etc.

columns.name: AUTHTYPE
columns.description: denotes whether authorization is authonly or authcapture.

columns.name: AVSCODE
columns.description: Address Verification Code from back end payment systems.

columns.name: ACQUIRER
columns.description: Merchant bank which may be optionally returned by payment system.

columns.name: AUXMSG
columns.description: Auxilliary message that may be returned by the payment system or processing system.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PONUMBER
columns.description: Buyer's Purchase Order Number

columns.name: TAXAMOUNT
columns.description: The amount, out of the total price, that consists of tax.

columns.name: SHIPFROMZIP
columns.description: The ZIP code from which merchandise is to be sent.

columns.name: SHIPTOZIP
columns.description: The ZIP code to which merchandise is to be sent.

columns.name: SECURITY_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Used in hosted environments

columns.name: VOICEAUTHFLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether Authorization was done manually

columns.name: CVV2RESULT
columns.description: CVV2 validation result returned by the payment system/credit card network.

columns.name: PROC_TRACENUMBER
columns.description: Processor trace/reference number column.  Required by certain processors.

columns.name: DATE_OF_VOICE_AUTHORIZATION
columns.description: Date Of Voice Authorization

columns.name: POS_READER_CAPABILITY_CODE
columns.description: Card reader capability at the point-of-sale from lookup type IBY_POS_CAPABILITY_TYPE

columns.name: POS_ENTRY_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Card entry method from lookup type IBY_POS_ENTRY_TYPE

columns.name: POS_ID_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Card holder identification method from lookup type IBY_POS_CARD_ID_TYPE

columns.name: POS_AUTH_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Card authorization source from lookup type IBY_POS_AUTH_SRC_TYPE

columns.name: READER_DATA
columns.description: Card reader data, encoded in a text format

columns.name: POS_TRXN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction occurred at a point-of-sale

columns.name: INSTR_EXPIRYDATE
columns.description: Expiration date for the card

columns.name: INSTR_SECURITY_VAL
columns.description: Security value

columns.name: CARD_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Subtype, used for purchase cards from lookup type IBY_PURCHASECARD_SUBTYPE

columns.name: CARD_DATA_LEVEL
columns.description: Purchase card data level from lookup type IBY_PCARD_DATA_LEVEL

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Card holder name, as a single string

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_ADDRESS_LINE1
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_ADDRESS_LINE2
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_ADDRESS_LINE3
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_CITY
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_COUNTRY
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_POSTALCODE
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_PHONE
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: INSTR_OWNER_EMAIL
columns.description: Card holder billing address information

columns.name: DEBIT_NETWORK_CODE
columns.description: Debit card network code

columns.name: SURCHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Debit card surcharge amount
